description: Election Commission - Notice declaring P. M. A. Munasingha elected as a member of the Horana Urban Council
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Horana Urban Council) due to the death of a member, following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the nomination and declaration of a new council member through electoral processes, which falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral matters including candidate nominations and declarations.
